claim_limits: Synthetic deterministic model and two-token teacher distributions; no pretrained model or downstream task success.
Bypasses async rollout/teacher workers, queue, planner, production DataLoaderDispatcher, FSDP, GPU, and model-scale behavior.
This reproduces an existing PR candidate and is not a new method, original fix, adoption claim, or external human replication.

estimand.objective: L(theta)=sum_i n_i KL(q_i || p_theta(.|x_i)) / N, where n_i is the count of active completion tokens in sample i and N=sum_i n_i; each teacher q_i is a normalized two-token distribution fully represented by teacher_topk_ids=[0,1].
estimand.oracle: Independent direct computation of the two-token forward KL on a deterministic token-local model, weighted by each sample's active completion-token count, divided by N; analytic autograd gradient and one SGD(lr=0.1) update.
primary_metrics: max absolute gradient error to pooled oracle
max absolute SGD parameter error to pooled oracle
secondary_metrics: global mean Trainer training-step loss error
estimand.update: One optimizer step; no weight decay or gradient clipping; beta=0; temperature=1; add_tail_bucket=false; same initialization and sample tokens in both source revisions.

This v1 tests that distinct trainer path through actual DDP; it does not claim algorithmic novelty or duplicate/fix upstream code.
